title: Colorful Hot Air Balloons Rising Over Cappadocia Fairy Chimneys at Sunrise
prompt: Dozens of colorful hot-air balloons rising over Cappadocia fairy chimneys and rock pinnacles at golden sunrise, with soft valley mist and warm side light, wide landscape 16:9. The warm sandstone fairy chimneys and eroded pinnacles fill the mid-ground across the frame; soft mist pools in the valley gaps between them. Many striped and solid-colored balloons float at staggered heights — some just clearing the rock tops, others higher as smaller shapes in the pale gold-to-blue sky. Warm sunrise light comes from the right, lighting the stone faces and catching the balloon envelopes; long soft shadows fall to the left. Photoreal travel landscape photography, calm, airy, wonder-filled morning mood. No people, no crowds, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
